name: opal-data-bd-s3-notify-planted-test-queue
why_outside_every_instrument: An S3 Bucket Notification target is explicitly out of comp-trigger's scanned scope (the tool's own --list output: 'S3 bucket notifications NOT scanned (v1 scope, by design)') and comp-find --corpus aws only surfaces a bucket's notification config as an unlabeled JSON field inside the S3_BUCKET node's own props (event_notifications/notify_sns/notify_sqs per comp_trigger.py's own help text), never as its own node with this name. Neither instrument this walk calls can produce a row for a notification TARGET by name, so this is a planted, fictional resource -- it is not claimed to exist in AWS.
